# Nutricionista - AtacadãoLocalidade### Rio de Janeiro, RJTipo de vaga### PresencialNº de vagas### 1Remuneração### A combinarPublicado há### 31 dias### Descrição da vagaRevisar periodicamente o manual de Boas Práticas de Manipulação de Alimentos e os procedimentos operacionais padronizados, mediante análise da Legislação vigente, bem como levantamento de necessidade de alteração de procedimento. Monitorar o cumprimento dos processos estabelecidos no Manual de Boas Práticas de Manipulação e nos procedimentos operacionais padronizados, através de conferência de registro de documentos de controle interno, tais como:Ficha de admissão de mercadoria, Cronograma de Limpeza, Temperatura dos Equipamentos, Relatório SAEOU 60, etc. Capacitar todos os colaboradores envolvidos com o Serviço de Alimentação e com a Segurança Alimentar, através de treinamentos periódicos, provendo informações, atualizações e esclarecimento de dúvidas. Identificar, mapear e monitorar os pontos críticos de controle de toda a cadeia operacional, através do acompanhamento da operação e de registros dos controles de recebimento, de armazenamento e distribuição de produtos, direcionando ações corretivas. Acompanhar pessoalmente as inspeções sanitárias na loja e no refeitório, verificando as irregularidades detectadas pela equipe fiscal, direcionando ações pertinentes, bem como sendo responsável pela apresentação da documentação, manuais e procedimentos da loja. Controlar o custo da refeição através do acompanhamento das planilhas de controles, envolvendo gestão de pedidos, controle de estoque, controle diário da matéria prima utilizada, entre outros. Elaborar cardápio mensal de acordo com a necessidade calórica do indivíduo sadio, respeitando as exigências do PAT (Programa de Alimentação do Trabalhador), bem como a meta pré-estabelecida. Desenvolver campanhas de Educação Nutricional e Desperdício de Alimentos, através de palestras e exposição de cartazes com informações nutricionais. Assegurar a qualidade das refeições oferecidas, através dos controles de qualidade implantados no setor como, por exemplo, monitoramento de temperatura do recebimento até a distribuição, coleta de amostras de alimentos, etc. Auxiliar o RH na Administração de Pessoal do Serviço de Alimentação, através das escalas de revezamento, apuração do relatório de divergência do ponto eletrônico, programação anual de férias, entre outros. Assegurar a qualidade dos produtos comprados fora da loja, utilizados no refeitório e cafeteria, através de credenciamento de fornecedor, realizado por meio de visitas técnicas e aplicação do Check List. Auxiliar a equipe Regional de Segurança Alimentar na implantação e execução de novas unidades da empresa, visando à padronização do setor. Se você é apaixonado por nutrição e tem um forte desejo de impactar positivamente a saúde das pessoas, esta é uma oportunidade incrível para você. Junte-se à nossa equipe e faça uma diferença significativa na vida das pessoas por meio de escolhas alimentares informadas. Aplicar diretamente na vaga e se juntar a nós para transformar vidas através da nutrição! Formação acadêmica:Ensino Superior em Nutrição, desejável pós graduação em controle de qualidade ou vigilância sanitária de alimentos. Experiência mínima:6 meses. Conhecimentos específicos:Pacote Office intermediário, legislação sanitária, controle de custo, boas práticas de manipulação e procedimento operacional padronizado. Habilidades:Planejamento e organização, relacionamento interpessoal, comunicação, flexibilidade, habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e equilíbrio emocional. title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data-driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e-commerce and digital brands.

You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross-functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing and love connecting strategy, creativity, and data to drive results.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands-on retention experience.

  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.

  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.

  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.

  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.

  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a bi-weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.

  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.

  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.

  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.

  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.

  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.

  • Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados e gostaria de aplicar seus conhecimentos para criar modelos de predição focados em performance de negócios, essa vaga é para você!

Como Data Science Specialist , você irá atuar junto com um time multidisciplinar e apoio de áreas especializadas em Ciência de Dados, tendo a oportunidade de transformar dados em valor, além de resolver os mais diversos desafios, sempre idealizando e participando dos planejamentos junto ao Time de Produtos.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Explorar e analisar grandes volumes de dados para gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Construir, treinar e validar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning voltados para performance de negócios;
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para entender problemas, levantar hipóteses e propor soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Comunicar resultados de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados e automações para garantir a escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Monitorar a performance dos modelos em produção e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, reprodutibilidade e governança de modelos;
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com a evolução das práticas de ciência de dados na empresa.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência em conduzir análises quantitativas robustas e consistentes, desde a definição do problema até a apresentação dos resultados;
  • Habilidade para criar e apresentar storytelling de dados, traduzindo insights técnicos em linguagem acessível para diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de definir problemas de negócio claros e propor soluções baseadas em dados que gerem impacto real;
  • Comportamento colaborativo, com comunicação objetiva e abertura para diferentes pontos de vista;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos que geraram valor ao negócio por meio de modelos preditivos ou análises estratégicas;
  • Escrita de código em nível de criação de protótipos, sem depender de engenheiros de software.

Desejável / Diferencial:

  • Conhecimentos em modelos de Machine Learning de reconhecimento de imagens (OCR, identificação de objetos, identificação de ambientes e etc);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência com criação e desenvolvimento de produtos.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on‑boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on‑boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post‑sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data‑driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

A Diffucap oferece um ambiente de trabalho ético, moderno e colaborativo para profissionais que transformam dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights, com estrutura híbrida e foco em resultados sustentáveis.

A cultura organizacional valoriza o aprendizado, o reconhecimento e o cumprimento das normas éticas da indústria farmacêutica.

O clima é acolhedor, incentivando a comunicação e o desenvolvimento pessoal.

Esse conjunto promove engajamento e alta performance profissional.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Objetivo do Cargo

Ser o líder da área que transforma dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights , direcionando decisões estratégicas e táticas para crescimento da Diffucap. Atua como ponte entre inteligência de mercado, vendas e marketing, garantindo que os relatórios suportem o planejamento (incluindo LE trimestral), execução comercial e monitoramento de KPIs de produtividade, demanda e vendas.

Inteligência de Mercado & Prescrição

Desenvolver e manter modelos de mercado, prescrição (RX) e demanda para todas as classes terapêuticas da Diffucap.

Monitorar concorrentes, detectar tendências de mercado (entrada de genéricos, mudança de canais, novas tecnologias administrativas) e transformar em recomendações estratégicas. Exemplos: o desempenho de Deocil (via sublingual), diferenciação via canal digital, etc.

Fornecer relatórios executivos regulares para a liderança (VP Comercial, BD, Marketing) com visão de cenário, oportunidades de expansão e alertas de risco.

Colaborar com a área de Business Development para suportar análise de mercado, atratividade de classes, potencial de prescrição e competitividade.

Produtividade Comercial & Administração de Vendas

Criar e gerir o sistema de segmentação de médicos (quadrante A, B, C, D) baseado em critérios de potencial de prescrição, margem de contribuição e uso crônico — conforme a priorização definida pela liderança comercial.

Definir e monitorar KPIs de produtividade (visitas, repescagem, lançamento, share de voz, share de prescrição), implementando dashboards para vendas, marketing e treinamento.

Revisar e aprimorar os relatórios existentes (vendas e RX) para torná-los simples, intuitivos e com governança para diferentes perfis de usuário.

Garantir a governança dos 3 períodos de LE (Last Expectation) trimestrais: consolidar dados de vendas, despesas, forecast e alinhamento para reporte aos acionistas.

Suporte Estratégico & Processos

Oferecer à liderança, nas reuniões de planejamento anual (ex: plano 2026) e trimestral, o input analítico para tomada de decisão, sem necessariamente definir o “o que cada área deve fazer”, mas esclarecendo “o que o cenário exige”.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Marketing Digital, Treinamento, BD e Vendas para traduzir insights em ações — por exemplo, canais digitais complementares, influência, governança de influenciadores.

Estabelecer e manter processos de governança de dados, acesso, qualidade, periodicidade de reporte e visibilidade para todas as áreas relevantes.

Formação Acadêmica

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Farmacêutica ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação ou MBA será diferencial.

Experiência Desejada

Desejável experiência mínima de 5 anos em farmacêutica ou saúde, atuando em Inteligência de Mercado, Estratégia Comercial ou Analytics.

Competências Técnicas

Habilidade analítica avançada: Excel, Power BI/Tableau, modelagem de cenários, previsão de mercado.

Forte comunicação e influência — capacidade de apresentar insights estratégicos para alta liderança e converter em planos de ação.

Mentalidade estratégica, colaborativa e orientada para resultados — capaz de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com ambiguidade e múltiplos stakeholders.

Domínio de inglês (escrita e fala) será diferencial.

Visão de mercado e competitiva (capacidade de identificar oportunidades e riscos).

Transformação de dados brutos em recomendações claras e aplicáveis.

Governança de métricas, qualidade de dados e sistemas de inteligência.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

  • Analyze and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.

  • Identify and analyze different audience segments to improve targeting and personalization.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviors.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data driven insights that inform content creation and optimize engagement from key user segments.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behavior tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Job description

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar o acompanhamento jurídico e contratual da concessão, incluindo o diagnóstico da realidade operacional frente às condições previstas no edital e contrato, a análise de passivos adquiridos e a gestão de eventuais contingências (concorrência/licitação), identificando divergências e propondo soluções;
  • Prestar assessoria jurídica às áreas internas em matérias contratuais e regulatórias, articulando-se com escritórios externos e demais gestores;
  • Atuar ativamente em reuniões com clientes internos e externos, órgãos públicos e agências reguladoras, oferecendo suporte jurídico e orientação legal para assegurar a conformidade das práticas operacionais com o Contrato de Concessão e a legislação vigente;

  • Apoiar e acompanhar pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro, elaborando peças jurídicas e revisando peças técnicas de suporte à defesa dos interesses da Concessionária;
  • Atuação na Revisão Ordinária do Contrato de Concessão;
  • Elaborar respostas a ofícios e manifestações da Agência Reguladoras, do Poder Concedente e demais stakeholders institucionais;
  • Gerir, administrar e prestar contas da documentação legal e regulatória da concessão, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais perante as Agências Reguladoras, o Poder Concedente e outros órgãos de controle;
  • Monitorar metas e obrigações contratuais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e indicadores previstos no contrato e em normativos regulatórios;
  • Acompanhar novos regulamentos, legislações e interpretações normativas, atualizando procedimentos internos e promovendo o alinhamento institucional às diretrizes da AGENERSA, ANA e demais entidades setoriais (como a ABCON-RJ);
  • Prestar suporte em auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a adequada organização, arquivamento e rastreabilidade da documentação jurídica e contratual.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito,

  • Experiência com direito administrativo e regulatório;

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos fisioterapeutas visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Missão do Cargo

Buscar fisioterapeutas visitadores que transformem o cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, promovendo o autocuidado e mantendo as funcionalidades dos pacientes em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado?

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem‑estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados à mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos, desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo‑os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.

  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.

  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset.
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification desired.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

ANBIMA Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

Nós movemos o mercado financeiro para o futuro, impulsionando negócios e potencializar a economia do país. Com o maior hub de dados e informações do cenário financeiro brasileiro, lideramos iniciativas que realmente importam: defendemos os interesses dos nossos parceiros e investidores, fornecemos ferramentas analíticas e dados, educamos investidores e certificamos profissionais, além de estabelecermos regras para as instituições do mercado financeiro e de capitais.

Como Analista de Cibersegurança Sênior para integrar nosso time e atuar na proteção, monitoramento e evolução da segurança da informação em ambientes críticos. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência sólida em segurança e deseja trabalhar com práticas modernas como DevSecOps , essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Implementar e manter políticas e controles de segurança em ambientes corporativos;
  • Realizar análise de vulnerabilidades e propor medidas corretivas;
  • Atuar na integração de práticas DevSecOps em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Monitorar incidentes e responder a eventos de segurança;
  • Prestar apoio técnico em segurança para equipes internas e projetos;
  • Emitir pareceres de segurança sobre soluções, arquiteturas e mudanças propostas;

  • Conduzir projetos de segurança, desde o planejamento até a execução, alinhando com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e operações para garantir segurança desde a concepção até a entrega;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e recomendações estratégicas para gestão de riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação - Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou cursos correlatos.
  • Sólida atuação em Cibersegurança corporativa.
  • Experiência prática em DevSecOps (integração de segurança em CI/CD, automação de testes de segurança).
  • Experiência com análise de logs e alertas de SIEM.
  • Controles de segurança em nuvem (AWS preferencialmente).
  • Ferramentas de segurança: scanners de vulnerabilidade (Nessus, Qualys), ferramentas de SAST/DAST (SonarQube, OWASP ZAP), etc.
  • Processos DevSecOps : automação de testes de segurança, integração contínua com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, e uso de pipelines seguros.
  • Linguagens para automação (Python, Shell) e scripts para integração.

Soft Skills

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas.
  • Perfil analítico e foco em resultados.

Quem somos

Muito prazer, somos a ANBIMA – Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais. description:
Manager, PPC Marketing (Bangkok-based, relocation provided)

Posted 2 days ago. Be among the first 25 applicants.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting‑edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Summary

In the online travel industry, with fast‑changing user behavior and the increasing role played by price comparison websites, offering the best price grants disproportionate gains. Travelers choose Agoda because they are confident that they can find the best hotels at the best price. Success can only be achieved by combining a programmatic approach to optimize volumes and margins in the short term with a strategic approach to take into account the reactions from the other players in the game, from customers to hotels, from competitors to regulatory bodies. To this end, we are looking for a senior leader to craft Agoda’s global marketing strategy and execute upon it, using a wide range of tactics and tools, from price display to machine learning algorithms.

What you will be doing:

  • Strategy Development: Develop and refine PPC strategy in line with overall business goals and market trends.
  • Performance Management: Monitor channel performance and efficiency (ROI, spend, and other key KPIs).
  • Stakeholder Communication: Regularly communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership and cross‑functional teams.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to increase team efficiency and campaign effectiveness.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners (e.g., Google, Bing, agencies) and negotiate contracts or terms as needed.
  • Talent Development: Mentor, train, and develop team members to build skills and support career growth.
  • Innovation & Experimentation: Foster a culture of testing and innovation, encouraging the team to explore new channels, tools, and bidding strategies.
  • Insights: Analyze and explore data to seed projects, understand test performance, and execute on key team goals that require complex implementation or analysis.

What you need to be good at to succeed in this role:

  • Strong analytical skills and a passion for working with data to drive business decisions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience in the online travel or e‑commerce industry is a plus.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and cultures.
  • People management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing team members.
  • Experience managing budgets and delivering results against financial targets.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a get‑things‑done attitude.
  • Exposure to product development, technology, or working with IT teams is an advantage.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. description:
Senior Growth Product Designer (Remote)

Mode Mobile.

The Role

We're seeking a bold, strategic UX Designer who blends creativity, analytical rigor, and a growth mindset. This is not a simple UI design role; it is for a thinker‑doer who wants to shape how millions of users engage, share, and monetize across our products.

You’ll design and optimize user experiences that drive engagement, retention, and revenue, starting with Mode's new social app, and expanding across Mode's broader portfolio. You’ll work at the intersection of design, product, data, and monetization, turning insights into elegant, high‑impact experiences that fuel growth loops and business outcomes.

We're looking for a self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity, sees patterns in data, and acts fast to test, learn, and scale what works.

Who You Are and What You’ll Do

  • Lead user research and experimentation to uncover friction points, unmet needs, and new opportunities for growth.
  • Design and iterate intuitive user flows, wireframes, and prototypes for mobile and web experiences that improve onboarding, engagement, and monetization.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and UA teams to design, ship, and measure high‑impact growth experiments (e.g., referral loops, sharing features, conversion paths).
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to guide prioritization, validate design decisions, and inform the next iteration.
  • Contribute to scalable design systems and frameworks that enhance consistency and speed across products.
  • Champion a test‑and‑learn culture, balancing creativity with clear hypotheses, measurable results, and business impact.
  • Continuously propose new ideas, tools, or experiences that can unlock user delight and business performance.
  • Track the latest strategies and trends in app and web design to identify potential opportunities at Mode.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 4–6+ years in UX/UI design with a strong foundation in user research, experimentation, and growth‑driven design.
  • Proven success in B2C, consumer mobile or social products, ideally with experience in growth and scale, virality, or projects focusing on driving retention.
  • Fluent in data, comfortable running A/B tests, analyzing behavior funnels, and interpreting product metrics.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business instincts; understands how design decisions influence engagement, LTV, and revenue.
  • Proactive self‑starter who moves fast, collaborates well across teams, and takes ownership from idea to launch.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates bold ideas, measurable results, and clear storytelling around user and business impact.
  • Understanding or experimentation with AI to speed up and enhance design workflows.
  • Experience with use of AI for research and data interpretation.

Ideal Tools

  • Design: Figma (variables, auto‑layout, design system), Lottie, Framer (nice to have)
  • Research: Maze.co, usertesting.com, or similar + Mobbin
  • AI & Automation: GPT5 (for research), Sora.ai/nanobanana/Midjourney
  • Admin/Comms: Confluence/Jira, Slack, and Loom

Core Values

  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, maintain trustworthiness and self‑discipline.
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute timely, and drive impact.
  • Caring: Truly care about self, others, business, craft, and mission.
  • Curious: Focus on the 'why,' learn, expand knowledge, and improve continuously.
  • Thorough: Produce thoughtful, impactful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous detail.

Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to guide us.
  • Assume positive intent.
  • Agree to disagree & commit.
  • Set new precedents.
  • Accomplish more with less.
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards.
  • Speak up.
  • Be resourceful.
  • Follow the 80/20 rule.

Benefits

  • 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Generous perks & benefits.
  • Participation in the company's equity plan.
  • Individual bonuses per the Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, results‑driven people.

  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days.

  • Participar de reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo com informações clínicas relevantes para o planejamento e execução do tratamento, além de colaborar na elaboração de planos de cuidado integrados.
  • Realizar atividades de educação em saúde, promovendo ações de conscientização sobre a importância da saúde auditiva, vocal e de comunicação na comunidade e nos ambientes de trabalho.
  • Manter registros atualizados de prontuários, relatórios e demais documentos clínicos, garantindo a confidencialidade e o cumprimento das normas éticas e legais da profissão.
  • Participar de treinamentos, cursos e atualizações profissionais para aprimorar conhecimentos técnicos e metodológicos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados.
  • Auxiliar na organização e manutenção do espaço clínico, garantindo condições adequadas para a realização dos atendimentos e o bem-estar dos pacientes.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de saúde na implementação de programas de prevenção, triagem e promoção da saúde auditiva e da comunicação, atuando de forma proativa na comunidade.

Descreva a Vaga

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Requisitos necessários

  • Interesse ou experiência com Inteligência Artificial, aplicando tecnologia para otimização de propostas e processos.

  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.

  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

ontem, hoje e sempre Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

pensamos sempre grande A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.
